thread:
Ava Chen: Quick sync on post-incident comms follow-ups from yesterday's outage. Need alignment on: statuspage wording, customer summary draft, RCA sharing policy, and remediation ownership/timelines. Propose we ship a short statuspage update by EOD and a more detailed customer-facing summary by Tue.

Jon Rivera: +1. Can you drop a one-paragraph draft for the statuspage? I'll review and post.

Ava Chen: Draft for statuspage (very short):
```
We experienced a service degradation affecting inference latency for ~45 minutes in us-east-1. Root cause: autoscaler cooldown interaction with KV cache eviction under bursty traffic. Impact: some requests experienced elevated latency and occasional timeouts. Mitigation: traffic routing fallback and cache TTL increase. Full follow-up and RCA to be published by Tuesday.
```

Priya Patel: That reads good to me. Suggest we avoid the word "outage" unless customers saw 100% failure — stick with "degradation."

Samir Gupta: I'll own the KV cache TTL fix. ETA: 48h for rollout + validation. I'll file the change as a patch release and add canary in us-east-1 first.

Ava Chen: Thanks @Samir — assign remediation action: `cache-ttl-adjust` -> Samir. Please link PR in the incident tracker.

Marta Reyes: I'll draft the customer-facing incident summary (3-paragraph) and include a short FAQ: "What happened?", "What did we do?", "What we're changing?" Will share a draft in #customer-comms for review by EOD tomorrow.

Jon Rivera: Regarding RCA sharing: legal asked we redact internal IPs and vendor telemetry timestamps before publishing. Priya — do we have precedent?

Priya Patel: Policy says publish a technical RCA unless it contains PII/security-sensitive logs. For vendor telemetry, redact raw timestamps and attach an aggregated timeline. I'll review Marta's draft for compliance.

OpsBot: Automated checklist created: [x] draft statuspage text, [ ] post statuspage, [ ] draft customer summary, [ ] compliance review, [ ] remediation PRs linked, [ ] confirm rollout. Deadline reminders set for 6h, 24h, 48h.

Samir Gupta: Note: autoscaler cooldown change is a separate action `autoscaler-cooldown-tweak` — I'll pair with infra to validate behavior. ETA 72h.

Ava Chen: Owner summary and timelines: Samir -> cache TTL (48h), Samir + infra -> autoscaler tweak (72h), Marta -> customer summary (EOD tomorrow), Jon -> publish statuspage (EOD today), Priya -> compliance review (within 24h).

Jon Rivera: I'll post the statuspage update in ~30m after a quick editorial pass. Please ping me on this thread if anything changes.

Marta Reyes: Draft will include the policy note about RCA redaction and a link to request more details via support if customers need them.

Priya Patel: I'll validate that the draft doesn't leak vendor-SRLs or internal endpoints and post comments inline.

Ava Chen: Recurring pattern note: this is the third autoscaler/cache related degradation in the last 6 months. We should add a recurring incident pattern review as an action item to the postmortem and consider an "autoscaler+cache" combined test in staging. Propose a follow-up meeting next week to decide longer-term mitigations. Who can attend?

Samir Gupta: I'll be there.

Jon Rivera: Count me in.

Priya Patel: Me too.

Ava Chen: Ok — action items posted to the incident tracker and owners assigned. Final checklist: Jon posts statuspage, Marta completes draft, Priya completes compliance review, Samir lands PRs and posts links. We'll reconvene Thurs 10am for pattern review. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: reconvene Thurs 10:00 (calendar invite sent).
